name: Opulent Arid Varlet
summary: The Opulent Arid Varlet is one of the mysterious so-called "Opulent" of the Night Market who control the Gilded, Argent and Brazen below them and is associated with the Parch. He can be found with the Knightshade and Web Eater in the Opulent Ordeal trial. According to rumors, he raised the Calamitous Dunegorger by feeding unlucky Daedra to it, and tortures any mortal he finds in his district.
